title: Holde'm Back :We’re making a tower defense roguelike where your poker hand decides who fights for you
author: DevandaLabs
selftext:
Holde'm Back we’re making a poker powered tower defense, and we’d love your support.  
Hey everyone! Im Tomas from Devanda Labs, and I wanted to share some gameplay from Holde'm Back with you.  
It’s a single player roguelike tower defense where your poker hands summon your fighters.   
You draw five cards, get one chance to replace them, and figure out how to make the result work for your defense.   
You can merge matching fighters, move them between seats to change their abilities, and reshape your deck between floors. All while climbing a casino where the bosses get to change the rules on you.  
We’re excited to finally share more of the game with people who enjoy TDs, deckbuilders.  
If the gameplay looks like your kind of thing, we’d really appreciate a wishlist on Steam.   
It would mean a lot to have you following along as we work toward release.

And feel free to ask us anything about the game we’d love to chat.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5016950/Holdem\_Back/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5016950/Holdem_Back/)

Thanks for taking a look ❤️

AI disclosure: Generative AI was used for some artwork and visual assets.
